selected_challenge.epistemic_limit: Survival of criticism leaves a claim unrefuted; pass counts, consensus, and confidence do not justify it.
selected_challenge.falsifies_if: critical_question=what operation of the system uses the represented difference and preserves it under semantic recoding; falsifies_if=adding role names without causal change converts a negative model into a positive one
selected_challenge.held_fixed: held_fixed_base=the same token stream, event order, external behavior, state names, declared boundary, and final artifact
selected_challenge.intended_case: positive_expected_classification=role_assignment_supported; discriminable internal states are used by available system operations in the claimed problem, conjecture, criticism, or standard roles
selected_challenge.lookalike_case: negative_expected_classification=analyst_labelled_twin_only; identical tokens are relabelled with semantic predicates after the fact while the system never uses the relevant differences
selected_challenge.oracle: status=interpretation_provisional; analyst resemblance and vocabulary substitution are insufficient for source role satisfaction
